incident-bot: :rotating_light: automated page fired for service=redwood-inference-runtime region=eu-west metric=p99_latency value=2.38s threshold=2.0s -- PagerDuty incident created PD-98321

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98321: triggered (acknowledge to stop escalation).

Maya: acked on PD. i'm on it, jumping in to triage. saw a small spike on dashboards, p99 jumped across multiple hosts.

Jamie: adding context — KV-cache evictions spiked ~2:59 UTC in eu-west, looks correlated with a routing fanout from a single customer (tenant-493).

Maya: thanks. can someone grab the hotpath logs? `kubectl logs -l app=inference-runtime -n prod-eu --tail=200`

Alex: pasting recent tail from one hotpod: 
```
I 02:59:12 request id=abc123 model=gpt-medium seq=1024 latency=2320ms batch_size=16 kv_cache_evictions=5 mem_pressure=0.82
I 02:59:14 request id=abc124 model=gpt-medium seq=1024 latency=2450ms batch_size=16 kv_cache_evictions=7 mem_pressure=0.86
```

Maya: kv_cache_evictions look bad, batching 16 on long sequences. probable hotkey or long-seq fanout. initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle tenant-493 routing for 5m, 2) reduce max_batch_size for eu-west runtime from 16 -> 8, 3) scale inference-runtime pool by +3 replicas.

Jamie: I can reduce max_batch_size remotely. running: `rdwctl set-config inference-runtime --region eu-west --max-batch-size 8`

Jamie: (done) config applied to rolling pods, will take ~30s to pick up.

Maya: scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime-eu --replicas=9 -n prod-eu`

incident-bot: Deploy/event: scaled deployment inference-runtime-eu to 9 replicas (triggered by Maya)

pagerduty-bot: PD note: Maya acknowledged PD-98321 and added status update. escalation paused.

Lucy: quick check — any customer-visible errors? SLO dashboards show a slight increase in 5xx for a tiny fraction of traffic around spike window.

Maya: checked logs for `request_timeout` and `backend_oom`. saw ~18 request_timeouts across 30m window, mostly from tenant-493. looks like degradation not full outage.

Alex: I can route tenant-493 to fallback model-variant (quantized) to reduce cost/latency. will push route override for 10m. ok?

Jamie: +1. do it. route override command: `rdwctl route set tenant-493 model=gpt-medium-q8 --region eu-west --ttl 600`

Alex: applied route override.

Maya: monitoring metrics now. p99 dropped to 1.8s after scaling+batch change+override. p95 steady at 350ms.

incident-bot: metric alert cleared for p99_latency (service=redwood-inference-runtime region=eu-west)

Maya: good. i'm going to leave a temporary throttling rule for tenant-493 to limit concurrent in-flight to 20 while we investigate upstream behavior. `rdwctl quota set tenant-493 concurrency=20`

Jamie: can we note action items for post-incident: 1) investigate tenant-493 request patterns, 2) add hotspot detection to routing to auto-fanout-protect, 3) rewiew KV cache eviction thresholds and improve locality.

Lucy: agree. also recommend adding a small safeguard to fallback automatically when kv_cache_evictions > 4 in 1m window.

Maya: capture customer impact: degraded tail latency, ~18 timeouts across 30m, estimated <0.02% of overall requests in eu-west. ops ticket #INC-4571 created for customer outreach/impact summary.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98321 updated: mitigation actions applied (scale, batch reduce, route override). awaiting follow-up and RCA.

Alex: leaving notes in the runbook and linking relevant dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/latency/eu-west-hotpath?orgId=1

Maya: handing off to Lucy for the remainder of the oncall window — summary: automated p99 page, root cause likely tenant-induced long-sequence fanout causing KV cache thrash and big batches; mitigations applied (scale + batch limit + route override + throttle). customer impact minor but requires follow-up.

Lucy: taking handoff. thx for fast triage. I'll own follow-ups and RCA. leaving PD acknowledgment and will add postmortem stub.

Maya: closing PD for now. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-98321: closed by Maya.

Lucy: quick FYI for next steps, I'll schedule a follow-up with tenant-493's account team and create an RFC for automated fallback based on KV eviction signals.

Alex: added action item to backlog: AUTOFALLBACK-221.

Maya: final check — re-open if p99 climbs back within the hour.

Lucy: noted.
